text: just seen a girl revising at 11pm with her phone face up next to her notes. no screen time limits. no greyscale. no forest. no deleting instagram at 2am and redownloading it by breakfast. just her and one second on tiktok that turned into forty minutes. brave i guess
base_video: Student sat at a bedroom desk late at night, highlighter in hand, open notes lit by a lamp. They stop writing, look straight down the lens with a flat sarcastic 'wow' face, then back to the page.
audio: original audio, room tone, faint keyboard and street noise
caption: one second on the phone is never one second
why_this_brand: The 11pm exam-week desk and the one-second-turns-into-forty-minutes scroll is the exact core pain Forest's app blocking sits on.

text: wrote my whole dissertation with slack open one tab away. no app blocker. no forest. no phone in another room. no study with me video keeping me honest. just me rereading the same paragraph five times between notifications and calling that a work day. not proud

text: table next to us at dinner. both phones face up beside the plates. no forest. no phones stacked in the middle of the table. no rule about waiting until dessert. just two people scrolling in silence for an hour and calling it date night. harrowing honestly
